experiments.name: high-unroll ALU-consumer chain
experiments.notes: L1D hit, load-to-ALU latency 4 cycles. The load-to-load address bypass path is 3 cycles. Measured with unroll=100000.

experiments.name: load-to-AGU bypass calibration
experiments.notes: Bare pointer chase: the word at address A contains A, so each load result is exactly the next load address. This exercises the load-to-AGU address bypass path (3 cycles), not the general load-to-ALU path (4 cycles).

latencies.notes: L1D hit. Load-to-ALU latency is 4 cycles; the load-to-AGU address bypass path is 3 cycles. The calibration experiment uses a bare self-referential pointer chase for the 3-cycle path; the measurement experiment adds add.d to force the ALU-consumer path.

throughput.name: 8 independent lanes
throughput.asm: ldptr.d $r12, $r20, 0; ldptr.d $r13, $r20, 8; ldptr.d $r14, $r20, 16; ldptr.d $r15, $r20, 24; ldptr.d $r16, $r20, 32; ldptr.d $r17, $r20, 40; ldptr.d $r18, $r20, 48; ldptr.d $r19, $r20, 56
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'addi.d $r20, $sp, -1024' --asm 'ldptr.d $r12, $r20, 0; ldptr.d $r13, $r20, 8; ldptr.d $r14, $r20, 16; ldptr.d $r15, $r20, 24; ldptr.d $r16, $r20, 32; ldptr.d $r17, $r20, 40; ldptr.d $r18, $r20, 48; ldptr.d $r19, $r20, 56'
throughput.notes: 8 independent memory operations take 4.00 cycles. Buffer is at $sp-1024.

notes: L1D-hit load-to-ALU latency 4 cycles. A bare pointer chase measures 3 cycles because it only exercises the load-to-AGU address bypass. Throughput is 0.5 CPI.
